contacts.name: Thomas Louis Calvet & Patricia Calvet
contacts.notes:
While still alive, Juliette had broken all contact with her family. They are under the impression that she had died in a tragic car accident - a staged one coordinated by her and Theodore.

Through the internet, she does from time to time “stalks” them - but from a respectful distance. More just a lingering connection of a life previously lived, but a chapter that had already closed the door behind.

contacts.name: Victor Delgado
contacts.notes:
Victor knows very little about Juliette’s true nature, however he is more or less the person she relies on for preparing the cainite for social events.

Convinced that the lack of mirrors is merely a quirk of yet another rich person, Victor isn’t asking questions. He gets paid, sometimes gets laid - at least the sensation of being fed on feels as such - and everyone wins.

He is a makeup artist with a zipper on his mouth, and very little to spoil anyway. Perfect for the purposes Juliette needs him for and she pays him well enough. He is about thirty-one, and perhaps eventually - should he live long enough, may become a ghoul for a long term employment. Juliette is grooming him to be such.

Relatively good looking man, though he definitely likes a good burger or a taco. Puerto Rican/Mexican mix, small mustache, well groomed black hair - and there is generally a colorful attire around him.

contacts.name: Sioux Fletcher
contacts.notes:
A contact, useful one - Juliette’s main source of semi-reliable information in Pittsburg. Sioux’ embrace is about the same as hers - without the attachments she got. No sire to speak of, learned most things on her own and later from Juliette.

Contrary to the lasombra however, she is able and quite good at using computers. So a sort of verbal contract is set between them, what Sioux learns on the net, she is willing to share with Juliette, in return - Juliette does the same - only from the streets.

contacts.name: Pjotr Dinovsic
contacts.notes: Pjotr - the claw - has been one of the few Juliette was introduced to by Theodore, a few months after her embrace. What his purpose in Pittsburg is, had never been revealed to the young cainite - yet Theodore warned her to be extremely polite in his presence. Whether this was due to the clan’s obsession with politeness or a difference in strength? She couldn’t deduct. He resides in an unused part of the sewers, with the help of some rather misshapen ‘tools’ carving a cave of a home for himself.

contacts.name: The Diver
contacts.notes: A serial killer. Creator of silent, terrifying art. Lures unsuspecting victims towards and into the Ohio river where he had set up an underwater gallery of cruelty. Yet another cainite who Juliette was briefly introduced to, Theodore did not want to linger too long in the presence of the creature, it clearly was disturbed and unstable enough.
